meaning: Every retained landing sample with full load/spring/damper sums and board-local requested impulses; all published sustained-unloading summaries. Intermediate substep operands were not retained, so sums of sampled axial terms cannot be called the full interval axial impulse.

basis.axial: world vertical demandUp=(0,1,0) in every retained landing sample; force N from attempted implicit leg solve
basis.deckNormal: board-local +Y requested impulse N*s, or divide by substep seconds for N
basis.foreAft: board-local +Z nose / -Z tail requested impulse N*s, or divide by substep seconds for N
basis.applied: world XYZ recorded projected/applied contact impulse; unilateral flight guard yields zero

landingSamples.axialForceBasis: Captured demandUp: world vertical during landing; attempted implicit solve before unilateral contact/fallback.
landingSamples.requestedImpulseBasis: Board local +Y up, +Z toward nose; demandLocalY/Z are N*s, divided by this contact substep seconds for N.
